title: राष्ट्रिय भेलाको तीव्र तयारीमा एमाले, एकताको सन्देश र चुनावी तयारी मूल लक्ष्य
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेकपा (एमाले) ले आगामी मंसिर २ र ३ गते काठमाडौंमा आयोजना गर्न लागेको राष्ट्रिय कार्यकर्ता भेलाको तयारी तीव्र पारेको छ। भेलामा देशभरबाट पार्टीका नेता, जनप्रतिनिधि तथा विभिन्न तहका संगठनका प्रतिनिधिसहित ३ हजार ४१४ जनाको सहभागिता रहने एमालेले जनाएको छ । भेलाको तयारीलाई अन्तिम रूप दिन आज पार्टी केन्द्रीय कार्यालय च्यासलमा पार्टी सचिव तथा संगठन विभाग प्रमुख भानुभक्त ढकालको अध्यक्षतामा तयारी बैठक राखिएको थियो । बैठकमा विभिन्न प्रदेशबाट सहभागी हुने प्रतिनिधिहरूको अवस्था, व्यवस्थापन र कार्यक्रम सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी तयारीबारे समीक्षा गरिएको छ । बैठकलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले स्थानीय निर्वाचनलाई केन्द्रमा राखेर पार्टीका नेता तथा कार्यकर्तामाझ एकीकृत सन्देश प्रवाह गर्नु भेलाको मुख्य उद्देश्य रहेको बताए । पार्टीको आन्तरिक जीवन, राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय परिस्थिति, जनजीविकाका सवाल र आगामी राजनीतिक चुनौतीबारे साझा बुझाइ निर्माण गर्दै पार्टी पंक्तिलाई स्थानीय निर्वाचनको तयारीमा परिचालित गर्ने लक्ष्य रहेको उनको प्रष्टोक्ति थियो । बैठकमा पार्टी सचिव पद्मा अर्याल, स्थायी कमिटी सदस्य प्रदीप ज्ञवालीलगायत नेताहरूको उपस्थिति रहेको थियो । विभिन्न प्रदेशका फोकल पर्सनहरूले आ–आफ्नो प्रदेशबाट हुने सहभागिताबारे रिपोर्टिङ गरेका थिए । उनीहरूले प्रतिनिधिहरूको उत्साहजनक सहभागिता रहने जानकारी गराउँदै तयारीका कामहरू तीव्र गतिमा अघि बढिरहेको बताएका छन् । संगठन विभाग प्रमुख ढकालले भेलालाई सफल बनाउन विभिन्न तहमा जिम्मेवारी बाँडफाँट गरी समन्वयात्मक रूपमा काम भइरहेको बताए । उनका अनुसार कार्यक्रमस्थलमा सभाहल व्यवस्थापन, मञ्च निर्माण, सजावट, प्रचारप्रसार तथा स्वयंसेवक परिचालनलगायतका तयारीलाई तीव्रता दिइएको छ। ढकालद्वारा प्रस्तुत विवरणअनुसार भेलामा ३४६ जना केन्द्रीय सदस्य, ८१ जना केन्द्रीय निकायका प्रतिनिधि, ५५ जना प्रदेश, भारत प्रवास तथा प्रवासी नेपाली मञ्चका प्रतिनिधि, ४४० जना जिल्ला तहका प्रतिनिधि र १ हजार ५०६ जना पालिका कमिटीका प्रतिनिधि सहभागी हुनेछन्। त्यसैगरी संघीय संसद् तथा राष्ट्रिय सभाका ३५ जना, प्रदेशसभाका १५५ जना, स्थानीय तहका प्रमुख तथा अध्यक्ष १९६ जना, उपप्रमुख तथा उपाध्यक्ष ३४२ जना र जनसंगठनका ९६ जना प्रतिनिधिको सहभागिता रहनेछ। काठमाडौंस्थित कार्की ब्याङ्क्वेटमा आयोजना हुने भेलालाई पार्टी अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओली, वरिष्ठ नेता विद्यादेवी भण्डारी, उपाध्यक्ष रामबहादुर थापा र विष्णु पौडेल तथा महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले सम्बोधन गर्ने तय भएको छ। यातायात व्यवस्थापनलाई सहज र व्यवस्थित बनाउन पार्टीले भेलामा सहभागी हुन आउने नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई सम्भव भएसम्म निजी सवारीसाधनको सट्टा सार्वजनिक यातायात प्रयोग गरी कार्यक्रमस्थलमा उपस्थित हुन आग्रह गरेको छ। एमालेले राष्ट्रिय कार्यकर्ता भेलालाई पार्टीको संगठनात्मक एकता थप सुदृढ गर्ने, नेता तथा कार्यकर्ताबीच साझा धारणा निर्माण गर्ने र आगामी स्थानीय निर्वाचनको तयारीलाई प्रभावकारी रूपमा अघि बढाउने महत्वपूर्ण अवसरका रूपमा लिएको छ। Kathmandu. The CPN (UML) has intensified preparations for the national cadre gathering to be organized in Kathmandu on Mangsir 2 and 3. The UML has stated that 3,414 people, including party leaders, people's representatives and representatives of various levels of organizations, will participate in the gathering from across the country. A preparatory meeting was held today at the party central office in Chyasal under the chairmanship of party secretary and head of the organization department, Bhanubhakta Dhakal, to finalize the preparations for the gathering. The meeting reviewed the status of the representatives participating from various provinces, their management, and preparations for the program. Addressing the meeting, General Secretary Shankar Pokharel said that the main objective of the gathering was to convey a unified message among the party leaders and cadres, focusing on the local elections. He made it clear that the goal is to mobilize the party ranks in preparation for the local elections by building a common understanding about the party's internal life, national and international situations, people's livelihood issues, and upcoming political challenges. Party Secretary Padma Aryal, Standing Committee Member Pradeep Gyawali and other leaders were present at the meeting. Focal persons from various provinces reported on the participation from their respective provinces. They informed that there will be enthusiastic participation of the representatives and said that the preparatory work is progressing at a rapid pace. Dhakal, head of the organization department, said that work is being done in a coordinated manner by dividing responsibilities at various levels to make the gathering a success. According to him, preparations including hall management, stage construction, decoration, publicity, and volunteer mobilization have been intensified at the event venue. According to the details presented by Dhakal, 346 central members, 81 representatives of central bodies, 55 representatives of provinces, India migration and expatriate Nepali forums, 440 district level representatives and 1,506 representatives of municipal committees will participate in the gathering. Similarly, 35 members of the Federal Parliament and National Assembly, 155 members of the Provincial Assembly, 196 local level chiefs and chairpersons, 342 deputy chiefs and vice chairpersons, and 96 representatives of public organizations will participate. The gathering, to be held at Karki Banquet in Kathmandu, is scheduled to be addressed by party Chairman KP Sharma Oli, senior leader Bidya Devi Bhandari, Vice-Chairmen Ram Bahadur Thapa and Bishnu Poudel, and General Secretary Shankar Pokharel. To make transportation management easy and systematic, the party has urged leaders and cadres attending the gathering to use public transportation instead of private vehicles to the event venue whenever possible. The UML has taken the national cadre gathering as an important opportunity to further strengthen the party's organizational unity, build a common understanding among leaders and cadres, and effectively advance preparations for the upcoming local elections.

बैठकमा पार्टी सचिव पद्मा अर्याल, स्थायी कमिटी सदस्य प्रदीप ज्ञवालीलगायत नेताहरूको उपस्थिति रहेको थियो । विभिन्न प्रदेशका फोकल पर्सनहरूले आ–आफ्नो प्रदेशबाट हुने सहभागिताबारे रिपोर्टिङ गरेका थिए । उनीहरूले प्रतिनिधिहरूको उत्साहजनक सहभागिता रहने जानकारी गराउँदै तयारीका कामहरू तीव्र गतिमा अघि बढिरहेको बताएका छन् । संगठन विभाग प्रमुख ढकालले भेलालाई सफल बनाउन विभिन्न तहमा जिम्मेवारी बाँडफाँट गरी समन्वयात्मक रूपमा काम भइरहेको बताए । उनका अनुसार कार्यक्रमस्थलमा सभाहल व्यवस्थापन, मञ्च निर्माण, सजावट, प्रचारप्रसार तथा स्वयंसेवक परिचालनलगायतका तयारीलाई तीव्रता दिइएको छ। ढकालद्वारा प्रस्तुत विवरणअनुसार भेलामा ३४६ जना केन्द्रीय सदस्य, ८१ जना केन्द्रीय निकायका प्रतिनिधि, ५५ जना प्रदेश, भारत प्रवास तथा प्रवासी नेपाली मञ्चका प्रतिनिधि, ४४० जना जिल्ला तहका प्रतिनिधि र १ हजार ५०६ जना पालिका कमिटीका प्रतिनिधि सहभागी हुनेछन्। त्यसैगरी संघीय संसद् तथा राष्ट्रिय सभाका ३५ जना, प्रदेशसभाका १५५ जना, स्थानीय तहका प्रमुख तथा अध्यक्ष १९६ जना, उपप्रमुख तथा उपाध्यक्ष ३४२ जना र जनसंगठनका ९६ जना प्रतिनिधिको सहभागिता रहनेछ। काठमाडौंस्थित कार्की ब्याङ्क्वेटमा आयोजना हुने भेलालाई पार्टी अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओली, वरिष्ठ नेता विद्यादेवी भण्डारी, उपाध्यक्ष रामबहादुर थापा र विष्णु पौडेल तथा महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले सम्बोधन गर्ने तय भएको छ। यातायात व्यवस्थापनलाई सहज र व्यवस्थित बनाउन पार्टीले भेलामा सहभागी हुन आउने नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई सम्भव भएसम्म निजी सवारीसाधनको सट्टा सार्वजनिक यातायात प्रयोग गरी कार्यक्रमस्थलमा उपस्थित हुन आग्रह गरेको छ। एमालेले राष्ट्रिय कार्यकर्ता भेलालाई पार्टीको संगठनात्मक एकता थप सुदृढ गर्ने, नेता तथा कार्यकर्ताबीच साझा धारणा निर्माण गर्ने र आगामी स्थानीय निर्वाचनको तयारीलाई प्रभावकारी रूपमा अघि बढाउने महत्वपूर्ण अवसरका रूपमा लिएको छ। Kathmandu. The CPN (UML) has intensified preparations for the national cadre gathering to be organized in Kathmandu on Mangsir 2 and 3. The UML has stated that 3,414 people, including party leaders, people's representatives and representatives of various levels of organizations, will participate in the gathering from across the country. A preparatory meeting was held today at the party central office in Chyasal under the chairmanship of party secretary and head of the organization department, Bhanubhakta Dhakal, to finalize the preparations for the gathering. The meeting reviewed the status of the representatives participating from various provinces, their management, and preparations for the program. Addressing the meeting, General Secretary Shankar Pokharel said that the main objective of the gathering was to convey a unified message among the party leaders and cadres, focusing on the local elections. He made it clear that the goal is to mobilize the party ranks in preparation for the local elections by building a common understanding about the party's internal life, national and international situations, people's livelihood issues, and upcoming political challenges. Party Secretary Padma Aryal, Standing Committee Member Pradeep Gyawali and other leaders were present at the meeting. Focal persons from various provinces reported on the participation from their respective provinces. They informed that there will be enthusiastic participation of the representatives and said that the preparatory work is progressing at a rapid pace. Dhakal, head of the organization department, said that work is being done in a coordinated manner by dividing responsibilities at various levels to make the gathering a success. According to him, preparations including hall management, stage construction, decoration, publicity, and volunteer mobilization have been intensified at the event venue. According to the details presented by Dhakal, 346 central members, 81 representatives of central bodies, 55 representatives of provinces, India migration and expatriate Nepali forums, 440 district level representatives and 1,506 representatives of municipal committees will participate in the gathering. Similarly, 35 members of the Federal Parliament and National Assembly, 155 members of the Provincial Assembly, 196 local level chiefs and chairpersons, 342 deputy chiefs and vice chairpersons, and 96 representatives of public organizations will participate. The gathering, to be held at Karki Banquet in Kathmandu, is scheduled to be addressed by party Chairman KP Sharma Oli, senior leader Bidya Devi Bhandari, Vice-Chairmen Ram Bahadur Thapa and Bishnu Poudel, and General Secretary Shankar Pokharel. To make transportation management easy and systematic, the party has urged leaders and cadres attending the gathering to use public transportation instead of private vehicles to the event venue whenever possible. The UML has taken the national cadre gathering as an important opportunity to further strengthen the party's organizational unity, build a common understanding among leaders and cadres, and effectively advance preparations for the upcoming local elections.

The CPN (UML) has intensified preparations for the national cadre gathering to be organized in Kathmandu on Mangsir 2 and 3. The UML has stated that 3,414 people, including party leaders, people's representatives and representatives of various levels of organizations, will participate in the gathering from across the country. A preparatory meeting was held today at the party central office in Chyasal under the chairmanship of party secretary and head of the organization department, Bhanubhakta Dhakal, to finalize the preparations for the gathering. The meeting reviewed the status of the representatives participating from various provinces, their management, and preparations for the program. Addressing the meeting, General Secretary Shankar Pokharel said that the main objective of the gathering was to convey a unified message among the party leaders and cadres, focusing on the local elections. He made it clear that the goal is to mobilize the party ranks in preparation for the local elections by building a common understanding about the party's internal life, national and international situations, people's livelihood issues, and upcoming political challenges. Party Secretary Padma Aryal, Standing Committee Member Pradeep Gyawali and other leaders were present at the meeting. Focal persons from various provinces reported on the participation from their respective provinces. They informed that there will be enthusiastic participation of the representatives and said that the preparatory work is progressing at a rapid pace. Dhakal, head of the organization department, said that work is being done in a coordinated manner by dividing responsibilities at various levels to make the gathering a success. According to him, preparations including hall management, stage construction, decoration, publicity, and volunteer mobilization have been intensified at the event venue. According to the details presented by Dhakal, 346 central members, 81 representatives of central bodies, 55 representatives of provinces, India migration and expatriate Nepali forums, 440 district level representatives and 1,506 representatives of municipal committees will participate in the gathering. Similarly, 35 members of the Federal Parliament and National Assembly, 155 members of the Provincial Assembly, 196 local level chiefs and chairpersons, 342 deputy chiefs and vice chairpersons, and 96 representatives of public organizations will participate. The gathering, to be held at Karki Banquet in Kathmandu, is scheduled to be addressed by party Chairman KP Sharma Oli, senior leader Bidya Devi Bhandari, Vice-Chairmen Ram Bahadur Thapa and Bishnu Poudel, and General Secretary Shankar Pokharel. To make transportation management easy and systematic, the party has urged leaders and cadres attending the gathering to use public transportation instead of private vehicles to the event venue whenever possible. The UML has taken the national cadre gathering as an important opportunity to further strengthen the party's organizational unity, build a common understanding among leaders and cadres, and effectively advance preparations for the upcoming local elections.

काठमाडौं । नेकपा (एमाले) ले आगामी मंसिर २ र ३ गते काठमाडौंमा आयोजना गर्न लागेको राष्ट्रिय कार्यकर्ता भेलाको तयारी तीव्र पारेको छ। भेलामा देशभरबाट पार्टीका नेता, जनप्रतिनिधि तथा विभिन्न तहका संगठनका प्रतिनिधिसहित ३ हजार ४१४ जनाको सहभागिता रहने एमालेले जनाएको छ । भेलाको तयारीलाई अन्तिम रूप दिन आज पार्टी केन्द्रीय कार्यालय च्यासलमा पार्टी सचिव तथा संगठन विभाग प्रमुख भानुभक्त ढकालको अध्यक्षतामा तयारी बैठक राखिएको थियो । बैठकमा विभिन्न प्रदेशबाट सहभागी हुने प्रतिनिधिहरूको अवस्था, व्यवस्थापन र कार्यक्रम सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी तयारीबारे समीक्षा गरिएको छ । बैठकलाई सम्बोधन गर्दै महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले स्थानीय निर्वाचनलाई केन्द्रमा राखेर पार्टीका नेता तथा कार्यकर्तामाझ एकीकृत सन्देश प्रवाह गर्नु भेलाको मुख्य उद्देश्य रहेको बताए । पार्टीको आन्तरिक जीवन, राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय परिस्थिति, जनजीविकाका सवाल र आगामी राजनीतिक चुनौतीबारे साझा बुझाइ निर्माण गर्दै पार्टी पंक्तिलाई स्थानीय निर्वाचनको तयारीमा परिचालित गर्ने लक्ष्य रहेको उनको प्रष्टोक्ति थियो । बैठकमा पार्टी सचिव पद्मा अर्याल, स्थायी कमिटी सदस्य प्रदीप ज्ञवालीलगायत नेताहरूको उपस्थिति रहेको थियो । विभिन्न प्रदेशका फोकल पर्सनहरूले आ–आफ्नो प्रदेशबाट हुने सहभागिताबारे रिपोर्टिङ गरेका थिए । उनीहरूले प्रतिनिधिहरूको उत्साहजनक सहभागिता रहने जानकारी गराउँदै तयारीका कामहरू तीव्र गतिमा अघि बढिरहेको बताएका छन् । संगठन विभाग प्रमुख ढकालले भेलालाई सफल बनाउन विभिन्न तहमा जिम्मेवारी बाँडफाँट गरी समन्वयात्मक रूपमा काम भइरहेको बताए । उनका अनुसार कार्यक्रमस्थलमा सभाहल व्यवस्थापन, मञ्च निर्माण, सजावट, प्रचारप्रसार तथा स्वयंसेवक परिचालनलगायतका तयारीलाई तीव्रता दिइएको छ। ढकालद्वारा प्रस्तुत विवरणअनुसार भेलामा ३४६ जना केन्द्रीय सदस्य, ८१ जना केन्द्रीय निकायका प्रतिनिधि, ५५ जना प्रदेश, भारत प्रवास तथा प्रवासी नेपाली मञ्चका प्रतिनिधि, ४४० जना जिल्ला तहका प्रतिनिधि र १ हजार ५०६ जना पालिका कमिटीका प्रतिनिधि सहभागी हुनेछन्। त्यसैगरी संघीय संसद् तथा राष्ट्रिय सभाका ३५ जना, प्रदेशसभाका १५५ जना, स्थानीय तहका प्रमुख तथा अध्यक्ष १९६ जना, उपप्रमुख तथा उपाध्यक्ष ३४२ जना र जनसंगठनका ९६ जना प्रतिनिधिको सहभागिता रहनेछ। काठमाडौंस्थित कार्की ब्याङ्क्वेटमा आयोजना हुने भेलालाई पार्टी अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओली, वरिष्ठ नेता विद्यादेवी भण्डारी, उपाध्यक्ष रामबहादुर थापा र विष्णु पौडेल तथा महासचिव शंकर पोखरेलले सम्बोधन गर्ने तय भएको छ। यातायात व्यवस्थापनलाई सहज र व्यवस्थित बनाउन पार्टीले भेलामा सहभागी हुन आउने नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई सम्भव भएसम्म निजी सवारीसाधनको सट्टा सार्वजनिक यातायात प्रयोग गरी कार्यक्रमस्थलमा उपस्थित हुन आग्रह गरेको छ। एमालेले राष्ट्रिय कार्यकर्ता भेलालाई पार्टीको संगठनात्मक एकता थप सुदृढ गर्ने, नेता तथा कार्यकर्ताबीच साझा धारणा निर्माण गर्ने र आगामी स्थानीय निर्वाचनको तयारीलाई प्रभावकारी रूपमा अघि बढाउने महत्वपूर्ण अवसरका रूपमा लिएको छ।

Kathmandu. The CPN (UML) has intensified preparations for the national cadre gathering to be organized in Kathmandu on Mangsir 2 and 3. The UML has stated that 3,414 people, including party leaders, people's representatives and representatives of various levels of organizations, will participate in the gathering from across the country.

A preparatory meeting was held today at the party central office in Chyasal under the chairmanship of party secretary and head of the organization department, Bhanubhakta Dhakal, to finalize the preparations for the gathering. The meeting reviewed the status of the representatives participating from various provinces, their management, and preparations for the program.

Addressing the meeting, General Secretary Shankar Pokharel said that the main objective of the gathering was to convey a unified message among the party leaders and cadres, focusing on the local elections.

He made it clear that the goal is to mobilize the party ranks in preparation for the local elections by building a common understanding about the party's internal life, national and international situations, people's livelihood issues, and upcoming political challenges.

Party Secretary Padma Aryal, Standing Committee Member Pradeep Gyawali and other leaders were present at the meeting. Focal persons from various provinces reported on the participation from their respective provinces. They informed that there will be enthusiastic participation of the representatives and said that the preparatory work is progressing at a rapid pace.

Dhakal, head of the organization department, said that work is being done in a coordinated manner by dividing responsibilities at various levels to make the gathering a success. According to him, preparations including hall management, stage construction, decoration, publicity, and volunteer mobilization have been intensified at the event venue.

According to the details presented by Dhakal, 346 central members, 81 representatives of central bodies, 55 representatives of provinces, India migration and expatriate Nepali forums, 440 district level representatives and 1,506 representatives of municipal committees will participate in the gathering.

Similarly, 35 members of the Federal Parliament and National Assembly, 155 members of the Provincial Assembly, 196 local level chiefs and chairpersons, 342 deputy chiefs and vice chairpersons, and 96 representatives of public organizations will participate.

The gathering, to be held at Karki Banquet in Kathmandu, is scheduled to be addressed by party Chairman KP Sharma Oli, senior leader Bidya Devi Bhandari, Vice-Chairmen Ram Bahadur Thapa and Bishnu Poudel, and General Secretary Shankar Pokharel.

To make transportation management easy and systematic, the party has urged leaders and cadres attending the gathering to use public transportation instead of private vehicles to the event venue whenever possible.

The UML has taken the national cadre gathering as an important opportunity to further strengthen the party's organizational unity, build a common understanding among leaders and cadres, and effectively advance preparations for the upcoming local elections.
